name: San-Ai Obbli Co., Ltd.
summary: San-Ai Obbli Co., Ltd. wholesales and retails petroleum products and liquefied petroleum (LP) gas. The company operates through five segments: Aircraft-Related Business, Chemical-Related Business, Gas-Related Business, Aviation-Related Business, and Other Business. It is also involved in the storage and related operation of petroleum products; and gas utility and pipeline service businesses. In addition, the company engages in the aviation fuel storage facilities operation; provision of aircraft refueling services; design, and consultation of airport fuel storage facilities and hydrant systems; sale and operation of energy-saving devices; and generation and sale of electric power.
